recent_posts.title: ㅤ
recent_posts.summary: A personal reflection on the nature of purpose and peace, arguing that real purpose isn't a career label or grand life mission but rather the quiet, daily commitment to improving your own life and the lives of those around you. The speaker contrasts society's pressure to define yourself through achievements with a gentler, more sustainable form of purpose rooted in small daily actions, kindness, and balance between dreams and inner peace.

recent_posts.title: Bash parameter expansion and shell string manipulation tricks
recent_posts.summary: A practical walkthrough of bash parameter expansion and pure shell string manipulation techniques. Covers substring extraction with offsets, case conversion, variable substitution, listing variables by prefix, default/fallback variable patterns using =, -, ?, and + operators, and here strings. Demonstrates why pure shell operations are faster than piping through external tools like awk or sed, especially at scale.

recent_posts.title: I moved to Wayland :D
recent_posts.summary: A personal account of migrating a highly customized Linux desktop from X11 to Wayland, using DWL (a minimal tiling compositor based on wlroots) as the window manager. Covers the patching workflow for DWL (vanity gaps, client opacity, floating windows), replacing Dmenu with a pure-shell alternative, switching to the foot terminal emulator, and extensively customizing a fork of Sunbar to display album art via Cairo and live-updating pywal colors. Also discusses eliminating a notification daemon by embedding notifications in the status bar, script migration challenges, screen recording quirks on Wayland, and unresolved Wine/Photoshop compatibility issues.

recent_posts.title: Essential Linux command line tools for desktop workflow automation
recent_posts.summary: A walkthrough of essential Linux command-line utilities for desktop workflow automation. Covers playerctl for media player control across browsers and music players, bat for syntax-highlighted command output, lm-sensors for hardware monitoring, xclip/wl-clipboard for clipboard integration in scripts, and chafa/ueberzug++ for displaying images in terminals. Demonstrates practical use cases like status bar customization, clipboard history management, and image preview in SSH sessions.

recent_posts.title: talking about anxiety
recent_posts.summary: A personal account of living with anxiety and irrational fears from childhood through adulthood. The speaker shares their journey of managing compulsive behaviors and intrusive worries through self-directed exposure therapy and cognitive techniques. Key strategies include embracing uncertainty with 'maybe, maybe not' thinking, finding mental clarity practices, and seeking validation from trusted friends. While acknowledging they're not a professional, they emphasize that different techniques work for different people and encourage seeking professional help when needed.

recent_posts.title: Overcoming procrastination through mindset shifts and practical techniques
recent_posts.summary: Productivity comes from showing up and trying your best, not achieving perfection. Reset your standards to view imperfection as acceptable—the only failure is never starting. Avoid comparison with others and accept that progress isn't linear. Two approaches help: training discipline in any area (which transfers to work) or recreating past motivated states by replicating the environment. A practical technique involves writing freely on paper to identify task-avoidance reasons, visualizing the work atmosphere, setting it up without committing to work, then staring at the screen in 5-minute intervals until boredom drives you to start.

recent_posts.title: the world-wide-web, right from your terminal
Building a shell script to scrape and display Aurora forecast data
recent_posts.summary: A walkthrough of building a shell script that scrapes Aurora Borealis forecast data from a website and displays it in a desktop status bar. The script uses curl to fetch text files and images, awk to parse and find maximum KP values from forecast data, handles timezone conversion with the date command, and uses ImageMagick to combine images. It demonstrates practical shell scripting techniques for web scraping, data extraction, and desktop integration with conditional notifications based on threshold values.

recent_posts.title: Learn Linux gradually by mastering basics before switching tools
recent_posts.summary: Learning Linux effectively requires patience and gradual progression rather than constant tool-hopping. Start with familiar desktop environments and default applications, spend time mastering fundamentals through the terminal, and only move to more complex setups like tiling window managers once you understand the basics. Constantly switching between distributions, applications, and configurations leads to unstable systems filled with leftover packages and configurations. Focus on deeply learning what's in front of you before chasing alternatives—this approach builds genuine understanding and creates a more stable, enjoyable Linux experience.

recent_posts.title: Complete guide to video editing with Kdenlive
recent_posts.summary: Kdenlive is a free, open-source video editor for Linux that rivals paid alternatives like Premiere Pro. Key features include keyboard-driven editing workflows, automatic proxy clip handling, robust visual effects, nested sequencing, and customizable keybindings (including Vim-style). The tutorial covers essential techniques like in/out points, insert/overwrite modes, project organization with sequences and guides, compositing, masking, and keyframe animation. While Kdenlive may lack some niche features found in proprietary software, it provides professional-grade capabilities for most video editing needs. The author emphasizes that editing skills and shot composition matter more than software choice.
